Name: Ahinoam the Jezreelitess
Summary: Ahinoam the Jezreelitess was one of David's wives, taken with him through his fugitive years and captured and rescued at Ziklag. She was the mother of Amnon, David's firstborn.
KeyStory: Ahinoam shared David's fugitive years, captivity at Ziklag, and the birth of his firstborn.
LifeLesson: The wives who shared the wilderness years are part of the king's story too.
